#Goal
Quantify SNP nucleotide diversity (pi) within each clade, without a MAF filter. The MAF>15% variant set used for association testing removes clade-private variation (a variant carried only by a 3-4 strain clade has a panel-wide MAF < 5%), so within-clade diversity is estimated here from the unfiltered 96-strain all-sites VCF. This is the R version of within_clade_pi.py; it produces the same matrices and checks that they match.

Filters

* SNPs only: a variable position is kept only if REF and every ALT allele are single bases (no "*"). InDels, SNP/InDel mixed positions and spanning deletions are dropped.
* SNP positions flagged LowQual by GenotypeGVCFs are dropped (no GATK hard filters).
* Non-variable positions are kept (they count towards the callable bases).
* A genotype is callable if DP >= 10, and at SNP positions also GQ >= 20.

```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(stringi)
library(parallel)
library(ggplot2)
MIN_DP <- 10
MIN_GQ <- 20
params
```

#What processing does the VCF record? (GATK steps in the header, and FILTER values)
```{r vcf-header}
header <- readLines(params$vcf, n = 5000)
header <- header[startsWith(header, "#")]
cat("GATK steps recorded in the header:\n")
print(unique(sub("^##GATKCommandLine=<ID=([^,]+),.*", "\\1", grep("^##GATKCommandLine", header, value = TRUE))))
cat("\nFILTER definitions:\n")
print(grep("^##FILTER", header, value = TRUE))
vcf_samples <- strsplit(header[startsWith(header, "#CHROM")], "\t")[[1]][-(1:9)]
cat("\nNumber of samples in the VCF:", length(vcf_samples), "\n")
contigs <- sub("^##contig=<ID=([^,]+),length=([0-9]+)>$", "\\1", grep("^##contig", header, value = TRUE))
contig_len <- as.numeric(sub("^##contig=<ID=[^,]+,length=([0-9]+)>$", "\\1", grep("^##contig", header, value = TRUE)))
data.frame(contig = contigs, length = contig_len)
cat("Total length:", sum(contig_len), "bp\n")
```

#Split the VCF into one file per chromosome (one pass over the 15.7 GB file)
```{r split-vcf}
dir.create(params$tmpdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
split_files <- file.path(params$tmpdir, paste0(contigs, ".tsv"))
if (!any(file.exists(split_files))) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  system2("awk", c("-F'\\t'", shQuote(sprintf('!/^#/{print > ("%s/" $1 ".tsv")}', params$tmpdir)),
                   shQuote(params$vcf)))
  cat("Split took", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1), "min\n")
}
# Only chromosomes that have records in the VCF.
has_data <- file.exists(split_files)
split_files <- split_files[has_data]
chroms <- contigs[has_data]
data.frame(file = basename(split_files), size_GB = round(file.size(split_files) / 1e9, 2))
```

#Parse genotypes and accumulate the pairwise matrices, per chromosome
For every pair of strains (i, j): D = differing allele pairs, C = allele comparisons (4 per position where both are callable). For every strain i: W = heterozygous callable positions, Wc = callable positions. D_sing / W_sing hold the part coming from panel-wide singleton SNPs (minor allele count 1).
```{r functions}
# Allele matrices (positions x strains, NA = not callable) for one chromosome.
parse_chrom <- function(file) {
  dt <- fread(file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", colClasses = "character", quote = "",
              showProgress = FALSE)
  ref <- dt$V4; alt <- dt$V5; filt <- dt$V7; fmt <- dt$V9
  variant <- alt != "."
  snp_ok  <- nchar(ref) == 1 & grepl("^[^*,](,[^*,])*$", alt)
  dropped_indel  <- sum(variant & !snp_ok)
  dropped_lowqual <- sum(variant & snp_ok & filt == "LowQual")
  keep <- !variant | (snp_ok & filt != "LowQual")
  dt <- dt[keep]; variant <- variant[keep]; fmt <- fmt[keep]

  # Position of DP and GQ inside each FORMAT string.
  ufmt <- unique(fmt)
  fkeys <- strsplit(ufmt, ":", fixed = TRUE)
  idp <- vapply(fkeys, function(k) match("DP", k), 1L)[match(fmt, ufmt)]
  igq <- vapply(fkeys, function(k) match("GQ", k), 1L)[match(fmt, ufmt)]

  n <- length(vcf_samples)
  a1 <- a2 <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow(dt), n)
  rows <- seq_len(nrow(dt))
  for (s in seq_len(n)) {
    parts <- stri_split_fixed(dt[[9 + s]], ":", simplify = TRUE)
    gt <- parts[, 1]
    dp <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[cbind(rows, ifelse(is.na(idp), 1L, idp))]))
    dp[is.na(idp)] <- NA
    ok <- nchar(gt) == 3 & substr(gt, 1, 1) != "." & !is.na(dp) & dp >= MIN_DP
    gq <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[cbind(rows, ifelse(is.na(igq), 1L, igq))]))
    gq[is.na(igq)] <- NA
    ok <- ok & (!variant | (!is.na(gq) & gq >= MIN_GQ))
    a1[ok, s] <- as.integer(substr(gt[ok], 1, 1))
    a2[ok, s] <- as.integer(substr(gt[ok], 3, 3))
  }
  list(a1 = a1, a2 = a2, dropped_indel = dropped_indel, dropped_lowqual = dropped_lowqual)
}

# Pairwise difference / comparison matrices from allele matrices.
accumulate <- function(a1, a2, chunk = 200000) {
  n <- ncol(a1)
  acc <- list(C = matrix(0, n, n), D = matrix(0, n, n), D_sing = matrix(0, n, n),
              W = numeric(n), Wc = numeric(n), W_sing = numeric(n),
              n_sites = nrow(a1), n_snp_sites = 0, n_singleton_sites = 0)
  for (st in seq(1, max(nrow(a1), 1), by = chunk)) {
    idx <- st:min(nrow(a1), st + chunk - 1)
    if (nrow(a1) == 0) break
    x1 <- a1[idx, , drop = FALSE]; x2 <- a2[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    called <- !is.na(x1)
    N <- called * 2
    maxk <- max(c(x1, x2, 0L), na.rm = TRUE)
    Ck <- lapply(0:maxk, function(k) (x1 == k & called) + (x2 == k & called))
    same <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(Ck, crossprod))
    NN <- crossprod(N)
    acc$C <- acc$C + NN
    acc$D <- acc$D + NN - same
    het <- called & x1 != x2
    acc$W <- acc$W + colSums(het)
    acc$Wc <- acc$Wc + colSums(called)
    counts <- sapply(Ck, rowSums)
    if (is.null(dim(counts))) counts <- matrix(counts, nrow = length(idx))
    nonzero <- rowSums(counts > 0)
    minpos <- apply(counts, 1, function(r) if (any(r > 0)) min(r[r > 0]) else Inf)
    sing <- nonzero == 2 & minpos == 1
    acc$n_snp_sites <- acc$n_snp_sites + sum(nonzero >= 2)
    acc$n_singleton_sites <- acc$n_singleton_sites + sum(sing)
    if (any(sing)) {
      Ns <- N[sing, , drop = FALSE]
      same_s <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(Ck, function(m) crossprod(m[sing, , drop = FALSE])))
      acc$D_sing <- acc$D_sing + crossprod(Ns) - same_s
      acc$W_sing <- acc$W_sing + colSums(het[sing, , drop = FALSE])
    }
  }
  acc
}

process_chrom <- function(file) {
  p <- parse_chrom(file)
  acc <- accumulate(p$a1, p$a2)
  acc$dropped_indel <- p$dropped_indel
  acc$dropped_lowqual <- p$dropped_lowqual
  acc
}
```

```{r run-all-chromosomes}
t0 <- Sys.time()
res <- mclapply(split_files, process_chrom, mc.cores = params$ncores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
errs <- vapply(res, inherits, TRUE, "try-error")
if (any(errs)) stop("Failed chromosomes: ", paste(chroms[errs], collapse = ", "), "\n", res[errs][[1]])
cat("Parsing + accumulation took", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1), "min\n")
names(res) <- chroms

site_counts <- rbindlist(lapply(chroms, function(ch) data.table(
  chrom = ch,
  callable_sites_kept = res[[ch]]$n_sites,
  snp_sites = res[[ch]]$n_snp_sites,
  singleton_sites = res[[ch]]$n_singleton_sites,
  dropped_indel = res[[ch]]$dropped_indel,
  dropped_lowqual = res[[ch]]$dropped_lowqual)))
knitr::kable(rbind(site_counts, site_counts[, c(list(chrom = "Total"), lapply(.SD, sum)), .SDcols = -1]))

sum_over <- function(key) Reduce(`+`, lapply(res, `[[`, key))
Cm <- sum_over("C"); Dm <- sum_over("D"); Ds <- sum_over("D_sing")
Wt <- data.frame(W = sum_over("W"), Wc = sum_over("Wc"), W_sing = sum_over("W_sing"))
dimnames(Cm) <- dimnames(Dm) <- dimnames(Ds) <- list(vcf_samples, vcf_samples)
```

#Callable positions per strain (genotype with DP >= 10)
```{r callable-per-strain}
callable <- data.frame(Strain = vcf_samples, callable_bp = Wt$Wc,
                       fraction_of_genome = round(Wt$Wc / sum(contig_len), 3),
                       heterozygous_sites = Wt$W)
summary(callable$fraction_of_genome)
knitr::kable(head(callable[order(callable$fraction_of_genome), ], 10), row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "10 strains with the fewest callable positions")
```

#Check against the Python output (within_clade_pi.py), then save the matrices
```{r compare-python}
py_C <- file.path(params$python_outdir, "C.tsv")
if (file.exists(py_C)) {
  pC <- as.matrix(read.table(py_C)); pD <- as.matrix(read.table(file.path(params$python_outdir, "D.tsv")))
  pDs <- as.matrix(read.table(file.path(params$python_outdir, "D_sing.tsv")))
  pW <- read.table(file.path(params$python_outdir, "within_strain.tsv"), header = TRUE)
  cat("C identical:", all(pC == unname(Cm)), "| D identical:", all(pD == unname(Dm)),
      "| D_sing identical:", all(pDs == unname(Ds)),
      "| W/Wc/W_sing identical:", all(as.matrix(pW) == as.matrix(Wt)), "\n")
} else cat("No Python output found to compare against.\n")

dir.create(params$outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(vcf_samples, file.path(params$outdir, "samples.txt"))
write.table(Cm, file.path(params$outdir, "C.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
write.table(Dm, file.path(params$outdir, "D.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
write.table(Ds, file.path(params$outdir, "D_sing.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
write.table(Wt, file.path(params$outdir, "within_strain.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
fwrite(site_counts, file.path(params$outdir, "site_counts_per_chromosome.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

#Clade assignments (Clades column of StrainsforSC-RNAseq.csv; "Wine/European (subclade 1)" merged into clade 1)
```{r clades}
single_cell_strains <- read.csv("/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Agrawal_single_cell_eqtl_cell_cycle/Figure.1/Fig.1-all-experiment-table/StrainsforSC-RNAseq.csv")
single_cell_strains <- single_cell_strains[single_cell_strains$Standardized.name != "DGY3", ]
clade_map <- data.frame(
  Strain = trimws(single_cell_strains$Standardized.name),
  Clade  = trimws(sub("\\s*\\(subclade.*\\)", "", single_cell_strains$Clades)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
clade_map$Mosaic <- grepl("^M[0-9]", clade_map$Clade)
stopifnot(all(clade_map$Strain %in% vcf_samples), nrow(clade_map) == 96)
table(clade_map$Clade)
```

#Within-clade SNP diversity (pi)
Pi of a set of n strains = average number of SNP differences per callable bp between two of its 2n genome copies (pairs between strains and the two copies within a strain). The permutation test compares each clade with 10,000 random sets of the same number of strains from the panel.
```{r pi}
pi_of <- function(strains, drop_singletons = FALSE) {
  i <- match(strains, vcf_samples)
  D <- Dm[i, i, drop = FALSE]; C <- Cm[i, i, drop = FALSE]; w <- Wt$W[i]
  if (drop_singletons) { D <- D - Ds[i, i, drop = FALSE]; w <- w - Wt$W_sing[i] }
  ut <- upper.tri(D)
  (sum(D[ut]) + sum(w)) / (sum(C[ut]) + sum(Wt$Wc[i]))
}
dxy_of <- function(a, b) {
  ia <- match(a, vcf_samples); ib <- match(b, vcf_samples)
  sum(Dm[ia, ib]) / sum(Cm[ia, ib])
}

clade_sizes <- table(clade_map$Clade)
multi <- names(clade_sizes)[clade_sizes >= 2]
set.seed(1)
pi_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(multi, function(cl) {
  s <- clade_map$Strain[clade_map$Clade == cl]
  obs <- pi_of(s)
  null <- replicate(params$n_perm, pi_of(sample(vcf_samples, length(s))))
  i <- match(s, vcf_samples)
  data.frame(
    Clade = cl, Mosaic = grepl("^M[0-9]", cl), `N strains` = length(s),
    `pi per kb` = 1000 * obs,
    `pi per kb (no singletons)` = 1000 * pi_of(s, drop_singletons = TRUE),
    `Mean strain heterozygosity per kb` = 1000 * mean(Wt$W[i] / Wt$Wc[i]),
    `Permutation p (pi lower than random sets)` = (sum(null <= obs) + 1) / (params$n_perm + 1),
    check.names = FALSE)
}))
pi_table <- pi_table[order(pi_table$`pi per kb`), ]

numbered <- clade_map[!clade_map$Mosaic, ]
panel_pi <- pi_of(vcf_samples)
between_dxy <- mean(combn(unique(numbered$Clade), 2, function(p)
  dxy_of(numbered$Strain[numbered$Clade == p[1]], numbered$Strain[numbered$Clade == p[2]])))
cat("Panel-wide pi (96 strains):", round(1000 * panel_pi, 2), "per kb\n")
cat("Mean between-clade divergence (dxy, numbered clades):", round(1000 * between_dxy, 2), "per kb\n")
cat("Median within-clade pi (numbered clades, >=2 strains):",
    round(median(pi_table$`pi per kb`[!pi_table$Mosaic]), 3), "per kb\n")
cat("Range of within-clade pi (numbered clades):",
    paste(round(range(pi_table$`pi per kb`[!pi_table$Mosaic]), 3), collapse = " - "), "per kb\n")

knitr::kable(pi_table, row.names = FALSE, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3, 4))
write.csv(pi_table, params$results_csv, row.names = FALSE)
```

#Clades 22 (Far East Russian) and 23 (North American oak) relative to the other clades
```{r clades-22-23}
num_tab <- pi_table[!pi_table$Mosaic, ]
num_tab$Rank <- rank(num_tab$`pi per kb`)
med <- median(num_tab$`pi per kb`)
sel <- num_tab[grepl("^(22|23)\\.", num_tab$Clade), ]
sel$`Fold below median clade` <- round(med / sel$`pi per kb`, 1)
sel$`Fold below panel` <- round(1000 * panel_pi / sel$`pi per kb`, 1)
knitr::kable(sel[, c("Clade", "N strains", "pi per kb", "Rank", "Fold below median clade",
                     "Fold below panel", "Permutation p (pi lower than random sets)")],
             row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
             caption = paste("Rank among", nrow(num_tab), "numbered clades with >= 2 strains (1 = lowest)"))
```

```{r pi-plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 7}
pi_plot <- pi_table
pi_plot$Clade <- factor(pi_plot$Clade, levels = pi_plot$Clade)
pi_plot$Highlight <- ifelse(grepl("^(22|23)\\.", pi_plot$Clade), "Clade 22 / 23",
                            ifelse(pi_plot$Mosaic, "Mosaic group", "Other clade"))
ggplot(pi_plot, aes(x = `pi per kb`, y = Clade, color = Highlight)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000 * panel_pi, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = `N strains`)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`Clade 22 / 23` = "#d6402a", `Other clade` = "#2a78d6",
                                `Mosaic group` = "#8e8e8e"), name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 5), breaks = c(2, 4, 8)) +
  labs(x = "Within-clade SNP diversity, pi (differences per kb, log scale)", y = NULL,
       title = "Within-clade SNP diversity (no MAF filter)",
       subtitle = "Dashed line: pi across all 96 strains") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
